This [[Sun Guard]], known only as the '''Thug leader''', was an underling of [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]]. During the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], he led a [[Coruscant mercenary|mercenary group]] that tried to [[Skirmish at Coruscant|kidnap]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]]. However, the plot failed, and he was killed by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Quarsh Panaka/Legends|Quarsh Panaka]].

==Biography==
In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="NEC" /> when [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Quarsh Panaka/Legends|Quarsh Panaka]] tried to escort [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], the Queen of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], to Senator [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] of Naboo, the Queen was [[Skirmish at Coruscant|kidnapped]] by the Thug leader and his henchmen, and taken to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] [[Restricted Area]]. Panaka rescued Amidala in the bowels of the city, and began to travel to the surface. In a darkened room just below Coruscant's surface, Panaka and Amidala were attacked by the Sun Guard. Wielding a [[Vibro-ax/Legends|vibro-ax]], he fought Panaka, but was defeated and killed after a long struggle.<ref name="PMvg" />

[[File:SunGuard2.jpg|thumb|left|150px|The Sun Guard.]]

==Behind the scenes==
The Thug leader appears in the [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (video game)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' video game]]. The mission the leader appears in contradicts the [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']] film; Queen Amidala was not captured in the film and went straight to the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]].

[[Evil Never Dies: The Sith Dynasties]] identified the Thug leader as a [[Sun Guard]].<ref name="END" />
